stem: A store reduces the price of a backpack by \(15\%\). A customer then uses a coupon that takes \$10 off the reduced price and pays \$58. What was the original price of the backpack, in dollars?
solution: Before the coupon, the reduced price was \(58 + 10 = 68\) dollars.
The reduced price is \(85\%\) of the original price \(p\): \(0.85p = 68\).
verify:
p = symbols('p')
sol = solve(Eq(Rational(85, 100) * p - 10, 58), p)
assert sol == [80]
v = sol[0]
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == v
